import sys
import math

def ckmn(a, b):
    return min(a, b)

def ckmx(a, b):
    return max(a, b)

def rd():
    return sys.stdin.read().strip()

def main():
    input_data = rd().split()
    n = int(input_data[0])
    m = int(input_data[1])
    mod = int(input_data[2])

    def add(a, b):
        a += b
        return a - mod if a >= mod else a

    def sub(a, b):
        a -= b
        return a + mod if a < 0 else a

    def mul(a, b):
        return (a * b) % mod

    def powmod(x, k):
        ans = 1
        while k:
            if k & 1:
                ans = mul(ans, x)
            x = mul(x, x)
            k >>= 1
        return ans

    def inv(x):
        return powmod(x, mod - 2)

    N = 505
    blok = [0] * N
    sum_arr = [0] * N
    dp = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
    ways = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]
    binom = [[0] * N for _ in range(N)]

    def c2(x):
        return ((x * (x + 1)) // 2) % mod

    def calc():
        binom[0][0] = 1
        for i in range(1, N):
            binom[i][0] = 1
            for j in range(1, i + 1):
                binom[i][j] = add(binom[i - 1][j], binom[i - 1][j - 1])

    calc()

    blok[0] = 1
    for x in range(1, m + 1):  # block size
        for i in range(1, x + 1):  # last element
            val1 = mul(blok[i - 1], mul(blok[x - i], binom[x - 1][i - 1]))
            blok[x] = add(blok[x], val1)

            val2 = mul(add(c2(i - 1), c2(x - i)), mul(blok[i - 1], mul(blok[x - i], binom[x - 1][i - 1])))
            sum_arr[x] = add(sum_arr[x], val2)

            val3 = mul(sum_arr[i - 1], mul(mul(blok[x - i], binom[x - 1][i - 1]), x + 1))
            sum_arr[x] = add(sum_arr[x], val3)

            val4 = mul(sum_arr[x - i], mul(mul(blok[i - 1], binom[x - 1][i - 1]), x + 1))
            sum_arr[x] = add(sum_arr[x], val4)

        blok[x] = mul(blok[x], x + 1)

    ways[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, m + 1):  # total size
        for j in range(1, i + 1):  # number of blocks
            for sz in range(1, i + 1):  # last block size
                val1 = mul(ways[i - sz][j - 1], mul(blok[sz], binom[m - i + sz][sz]))
                ways[i][j] = add(ways[i][j], val1)

                val2 = mul(ways[i - sz][j - 1], mul(sum_arr[sz], binom[m - i + sz][sz]))
                dp[i][j] = add(dp[i][j], val2)

                val3 = mul(dp[i - sz][j - 1], mul(blok[sz], binom[m - i + sz][sz]))
                dp[i][j] = add(dp[i][j], val3)

    ans = 0
    for i in range(1, m + 1):  # number of blocks
        zero = n - m
        lef = zero - (i - 1)
        if lef >= 0:
            ans = add(ans, mul(dp[m][i], binom[i + lef][lef]))

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
